basis: grid-05 actual candidate failures, one primary behavioral category per case; not proven causal ownership

owners_to_examine.field_misattribution: Tool output model-facing presentation plus model interpretation; original Effect identity remains correct
owners_to_examine.partial_to_global_absence: Coverage communication and model stopping judgment; literal no-hit is not semantic absence

owners_to_examine.early_stop_after_background: Discovery/Context guidance and model continuation choice; no default evidence-sufficiency verifier
